shortDescription: Tropical Storm Edouard has made landfall near Johnson Bayou, Louisiana, the U.S. National Hurricane Center said in its latest advisory on Tuesday.The Miami-based forecaster added that maximum sustained winds are at 60 miles per hour (95 KM/H).
